Built odin2-dust2-monty ecosystem, supports explicit user-specified change points full Bayesian inference, enabling interpretable evaluation intervention effects epidemic dynamics.

what: Example: 2009 Influenza A(H1N1), Pennsylvania school outbreak
title: Mechanistic Time-Varying Rt(t) Estimation Using Odin-Monty
text: example uses Flu2009 dataset EpiEstim package. outbreak comprised 129 cases 32 days school 369 students, known school closure day 18 24. Change points set days 1, 8, 18, 25, third block capturing period school closure. Blockwise Rt estimates decline outbreak, ~1.36 first block ~0.86 final block, notable drop ~0.41 school closure period (days 18–24). full methodology validation results, see accompanying thesis report.
code: library(odin2) library(dust2) library(monty) library(rodent) library(EpiEstim) library(dplyr)   # Prepare incidence data data(Flu2009) flu_daily <- Flu2009$incidence |>   mutate(time = row_number()) |>   rename(cases = I) |>   select(time, cases) |>   as.data.frame()  # Fit rodent out_flu <- estimate_R_blocks(   data        = flu_daily,   N           = 369,   gamma       = 1 / 2.6,   beta_breaks = c(1, 8, 18, 25),   priors = list(mean_beta = log(0.5), sd_beta = 0.5,                 rw_sd_beta = 0.3, mean_I0 = log(5), sd_I0 = 0.5) )  # View Rt series and plot # View Rt estimates (median and 95% credible intervals) head(out_flu$Rt_quantiles)  # View beta estimates head(out_flu$beta_t_quantiles)  # View susceptible trajectory head(out_flu$S_quantiles)  # Plot Rt library(ggplot2)  ggplot(out_flu$Rt_quantiles, aes(x = time)) +   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), alpha = 0.3) +   geom_line(aes(y = median)) +   geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +   labs(x = "Time (days)", y = "Rt",        title = "Estimated Rt — Influenza H1N1 2009, Pennsylvania")

title: Package Workflow Overview — estimate_R_blocks
text: High-level idea: Model transmission SIR system β(t) piecewise-constant user-defined time blocks, γ fixed, initial infectious count I0 unknown. R_t computed R_t = (β(t) / γ) * S(t) / N Infer unknown parameters (β-blocks I0) sampling posterior using random-walk MH sampler. likelihood evaluated integrating SIR system observed daily incidence Propagate posterior uncertainty simulating S(t) many posterior draws computing pointwise R_t quantiles

title: Package Workflow Overview — estimate_R_blocks
text: Model specification States: S(t), (t), R(t) S + + R = N. Transmission: β(t) = β_k t block k (piecewise constant). Removal/recovery: fixed γ. Initial conditions: I0 unknown (inferred), S0 = N - I0 (pre-existing immunity basic version; can extended include R0 > 0 needed). Reproduction number: R_t = (β(t) / γ) * S(t) / N Rt(t) stepwise beta(t), fixed gamma; infer I0 beta blocks via Metropolis-Hastings random walk MCMC Using full odin2 -> dust2 -> monty workflow (deterministic likelihood) log-posterior = loglikelihood + logprior
